text: We are looking for a backend engineer to build and maintain REST services in Python with FastAPI, backed by PostgreSQL. You will containerise the services with Docker and deploy them on Kubernetes.
Frontend developer, React and TypeScript, with solid CSS. Experience with Next.js and server-side rendering is a plus. You will work with designers in Figma.
Data engineer to own our ingestion pipelines. Daily work is Spark on Databricks, Airflow for orchestration, and SQL everywhere. Data lands in S3 and is modelled with dbt.
Machine learning engineer. You will train and serve deep learning models in PyTorch, track experiments, and ship inference behind a gRPC API running on GPU instances.
Site reliability engineer. Terraform for infrastructure, Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring, and on-call rotation. Strong Linux and Bash required.
Android developer, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and the Android SDK. You will integrate REST APIs and publish to the Play Store.
Security analyst. You will run penetration tests, review findings against OWASP, and write detection rules for our SIEM. Scripting in Python expected.
Quantitative analyst. Time series modelling in Python with pandas and NumPy, statistical inference, and backtesting of trading strategies.
Full stack engineer. Node and Express on the server, React on the client, MongoDB for storage. CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
Embedded software engineer. C and C++ on ARM Cortex-M, RTOS, and debugging over JTAG. Knowledge of CAN bus is appreciated.
Cloud architect, AWS. You will design multi-account landing zones, manage IAM, and bring costs under control. Infrastructure as code with CloudFormation.
NLP researcher. You will fine-tune transformer models with Hugging Face, evaluate on benchmark datasets, and publish your results.
Database administrator. PostgreSQL and MySQL in production, replication, query tuning, backup and restore procedures.
QA automation engineer. Selenium and Playwright for end-to-end tests, pytest for unit tests, and integration with our Jenkins pipeline.
Product designer. User research, wireframing, prototyping in Figma, and running usability tests. You will maintain our design system.
Five years building distributed systems in Go. Designed an event pipeline on Kafka serving 40k messages per second, with Redis for hot state and gRPC between services.
Data scientist. Built churn models with scikit-learn and XGBoost, deployed them as batch jobs, and presented results to the commercial team. Comfortable in SQL and Tableau.
I maintain our Kubernetes clusters with Helm charts, write the Terraform that provisions them on GCP, and keep the GitLab CI pipelines green.
Java backend developer with Spring Boot. Worked on a payments service with Hibernate over Oracle, messaging over RabbitMQ, and unit tests in JUnit.
Research engineer in computer vision. Trained segmentation networks on medical images, wrote the CUDA kernels for the custom loss, and ran the jobs on a Slurm cluster.
I led a team of six, ran the sprint planning, managed stakeholders, and still reviewed most of the pull requests myself.
Statistician. Mixed effects models in R, survival analysis with Cox regression, and reproducible reports in R Markdown.
Built the firm's reporting stack: Snowflake as the warehouse, dbt for the transformations, Looker on top, and Fivetran for ingestion.
iOS engineer. Swift and SwiftUI, Core Data for persistence, and a shared networking layer written with async/await.
Freelance web developer. WordPress and PHP for most clients, some Laravel, plus the usual HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Senior Python developer
DevOps
You will not need any frontend experience for this role; the work is entirely backend Python and SQL.
The office is in the 9th arrondissement, lunch vouchers, four days remote per month, and a very good coffee machine.
Nous recherchons un ingenieur data maitrisant Python, Spark et SQL, avec une experience de Kubernetes.
